Cultural Heritage & Tourism Promotion App

An AI-powered Android app built to explore and preserve Malawi's culture and tourism. Features an intelligent cultural AI guide, self-guided tours to Likoma Island, Nyika Plateau, and Lake Malawi beaches — plus a community storytelling platform, artisan marketplace, and gamification.

Who I Am

About Me

I'm Clive Luwanja, a Computer Science graduate from DMI St John The Baptist University in Malawi. I'm passionate about building technology that solves real problems — from AI-powered apps that showcase Malawi's culture, to clean web experiences that just work.

When I'm not coding, you'll find me rock climbing, shooting photography across Malawi's stunning landscapes, or volunteering with communities I care about. I believe great software is a lot like great photography — it's about seeing the right angle and having the patience to get the shot right.

I'm currently open to internships, freelance work, and full-time opportunities — especially in mobile development, AI integration, and impactful tech for Africa.
